doc: Tech tree placement for this content. Also accepts a plain string, treated as 'parent'.

parent.doc: Name of the parent tech tree node; required unless 'root' is true.

requirements.doc: Overrides the default research cost, which is this content's build cost.

objectives.doc: Extra objectives to complete; items/liquids get a Produce objective automatically.

planet.doc: Name of the planet this node belongs to; inherited from the parent otherwise.

root.doc: If true, this is a root node and 'parent' is not required.

name.doc: Display name for a root node; ignored for non-root nodes.

requiresUnlock.doc: If true, a root node isn't unlocked by default.
